mapper.sql: SELECT O.OFC_CODE, O.KANM, O.SIDO_CODE, S.SIDO_NM FROM TB_OFC_REG_MGT O LEFT JOIN TB_CO_SIDO S ON S.SIDO_CODE = O.SIDO_CODE
mapper.select:
(O.OFC_CODE LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR O.KANM LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%')
ORDER BY O.OFC_CODE
WHERE O.OFC_CODE = CAST(#{ofcCode} AS CHAR(6))

SELECT PER_NO, NAME, JIKEUB_NAME, SAMUSO, SAMUSO_NAME FROM TB_INSA WHERE (TRIM(RETIRE_DATE) IS NULL OR SUBSTR(RETIRE_DATE, 1, 8) > #{today})
AND TRIM(SAMUSO) = #{ofcCode}
AND (NAME LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR PER_NO LIKE #{q} || '%')
ORDER BY NAME, PER_NO FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY
SELECT PER_NO, NAME, JIKEUB_NAME, SAMUSO, SAMUSO_NAME FROM TB_INSA WHERE PER_NO = #{perNo}
SELECT CODE AS VEND_CODE, CODE_NM AS VEND_NM FROM TB_CO_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE = #{codeType} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORD, CODE
SELECT VEND_CODE, NULL AS VEND_NM FROM (SELECT VEND_CODE FROM TB_CO_MODEL UNION SELECT VEND_CODE FROM TB_MCN_INFO) WHERE TRIM(VEND_CODE) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY VEND_CODE

SELECT M.OFC_CODE, M.MCN_NO, RTRIM(M.INST_PST_CODE) AS INST_PST_CODE, P.INST_PST_NM, M.SRC, S.SRC_NM, M.KOM_TYPE, M.VEND_CODE, M.USE_YN FROM TB_MCN_INFO M LEFT JOIN TB_SCRT_INST_PST P ON P.OFC_CODE = M.OFC_CODE AND P.INST_PST_CODE = RTRIM(M.INST_PST_CODE) LEFT JOIN TB_NMS_SRC S ON S.SRC = M.SRC WHERE M.OFC_CODE = CAST(#{ofcCode} AS CHAR(6))
AND M.VEND_CODE = #{vendCode}
AND M.MCN_NO LIKE '%' || #{q} || '%'
ORDER BY M.MCN_NO
SELECT OFC_CODE, INST_PST_CODE, INST_PST_NM, USE_YN FROM TB_SCRT_INST_PST WHERE OFC_CODE = CAST(#{ofcCode} AS CHAR(6)) ORDER BY INST_PST_CODE
SELECT CODE_TYPE, CODE, CODE_NM, DESC1, DESC2, DESC3, SORT_ORD, USE_YN FROM TB_CO_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE = #{codeType} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORD, CODE
SELECT SIDO_CODE, SIDO_NM FROM TB_CO_SIDO ORDER BY SIDO_CODE
SELECT SIDO_CODE, SIGUN_CODE, SIGUN_NM FROM TB_CO_SIGUN WHERE SIDO_CODE = #{sidoCode} ORDER BY SIGUN_CODE
SELECT HDAY_DT, DAY_TYPE, HDAY_YN, CLOSE_YN FROM TB_NMS_HDAY WHERE HDAY_DT BETWEEN CAST(#{from} AS CHAR(8)) AND CAST(#{to} AS CHAR(8)) ORDER BY HDAY_DT
SELECT DISTINCT KOM_TYPE AS VALUE FROM TB_MCN_INFO WHERE TRIM(KOM_TYPE) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY VALUE
SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(OP_TYPE) AS VALUE FROM TB_MCN_INFO WHERE TRIM(OP_TYPE) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY VALUE
SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(INOUT_TYPE) AS VALUE FROM TB_MCN_INFO WHERE TRIM(INOUT_TYPE) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY VALUE
SELECT DISTINCT RTRIM(CNR_PST_SPEC_CODE) AS VALUE FROM TB_MCN_INFO WHERE TRIM(CNR_PST_SPEC_CODE) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY VALUE
SELECT DISTINCT VEND_CODE AS VALUE FROM TB_MCN_INFO WHERE TRIM(VEND_CODE) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY VALUE
SELECT DISTINCT MCN_TYPE AS VALUE FROM TB_CO_MODEL WHERE TRIM(MCN_TYPE) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY VALUE
